snippet.title: Fleshgrinder Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
The first gameplay trailer of the upcoming pc game Fleshgrinder.

Check out the Steam Page and try the demo if you want:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5074630/Fleshgrinder/

More links including discord and full game features description below.

Music:

​@WhiteBatAudio  - The town that dreded sundown

@yenmania - Virus


The game has 30+ weapons, 100+ armors, augmentstions and deep randomized looting system. 

Ammo type based penetration system through objects and entities,

dismemberment system based on body parts hit,

XP / lvlup system with skill trees, 
stat distribution system,

inventory management with weight limits, 

randomized mission areas,

NPC interactions through dialogue, 
lots of sidequests with multiple endings, 
faction and reputation system.

4 different difficulties where higher ones feature friendly fire - your roster is a max of 3 operatives with permadeath in an optional hardcore mode.

All NPCs can be killed and looted with permanent consequences

Set in a huge persistent world
where everything stays as is.

Use the terrain and props to your advantage - haul explosive barrels in doorways and other key positions before setting off a horde to blow them up - or drag some furniture in their way to slow them down / make them destroy them.

Fleshgrinder (designation XR-107) is a digital, intelligent virus developed by SynTech thats main purpose is to collect biomass from humans through its infrastructure system - let it work its machines harvesting lesser humanoids and see a Genesis Tier upgrade - a permanent strengthening of all 11+ unique monster categories across the game world and spawn a horde to attack you that will chase you across the world.

In-house built engine that
supports up to 1k monsters at one time on a mission!
Hope you are packing some real firepower and ammo because they wont stop until you or they are all dead!

___FLESHGRINDER:___
Evolution Without Waiting. 
Extinction Without Mercy.


https://www.fleshgrinder.com

https://fleshgrinder.itch.io/

https://discord.gg/yMuW6dPrhF

https://www.reddit.com/r/Fleshgrinder/
